# Amr Binniyaz

> Amr Binniyaz is a UK-based QA lead and front-end developer with 9+ years of experience: leading quality across a platform of 250+ school websites — accessibility (WCAG), Core Web Vitals, manual and automated testing — building internal QA tooling, and designing and developing websites for clients.

- Role: QA Lead & Front-end Developer
- Based: High Wycombe, United Kingdom
- Focus: Quality assurance, Test automation, Web accessibility, WCAG, Core Web Vitals, Front-end development, Web design, UI design, Branding, Illustration
- Contact: amrbinniyaz@gmail.com
- Profile: https://github.com/amrbinniyaz

## Case studies

- [Apex — School Admissions Website](https://amrniyaz.com/work/apex-international-school/): A school website for Apex International School in Kozhikode, built to turn interest into admissions: a warm first impression of school life, clear proof of results, and an easy route to enquire or book a visit.
- [Vegan Valley — Rooted in Motion](https://amrniyaz.com/work/vegan-valley-3d/): An interactive plant-based brand website that brings the product into the page: a real-time 3D bottle, scroll-led storytelling and a colourful route from first impression to flavour discovery.
- [Melahah — Marine Consulting](https://amrniyaz.com/work/melahah/): A marine consulting website for a client in Saudi Arabia, pairing maritime imagery with a clear route through expertise, company values and enquiries.
- [Integrated — Industrial Supply](https://amrniyaz.com/work/integrated-ksa/): An industrial supplier website for Integrated Technical Trading in Saudi Arabia, connecting heavy equipment imagery, sector expertise and a clear product catalogue.
- [Content Migration Tool](https://amrniyaz.com/work/content-migration-tool/): A website content migration tool that captures existing pages, supports content review and editing, rebuilds the sitemap, and transfers the approved structure into a CMS.
- [Client A11y — Accessibility Monitoring](https://amrniyaz.com/work/accessibility-audit/): An internal dashboard that runs Lighthouse and axe-core against 270 client sites, keeps every score as history rather than a snapshot, and turns each failure into a recommendation someone can actually act on.
- [BugHerd Dashboard — Bug Trend Analytics](https://amrniyaz.com/work/bugherd-dashboard/): An analytics layer over BugHerd that mirrors 227 client projects into a local database, records every status change as it happens, and turns a bug board into a trend you can make a decision from.
